title: ProjectTemplateUpdate
description: Replaces a template's name, configuration, and General section in one write.

name.description: Display name, validated like the create request.

GeneralDefaults.description:
Project-level defaults applied to videos added from now on.

Existing queue entries keep the input and output they were created with. The defaults are
stored on the project rather than inferred at add time, so the LAN browser and the desktop
window add the same video from the same document.

ffms2_filters.description:
Native FFMS2 filters, kept as the engine's own typed JSON so the contract never
mirrors an enum that changes with the engine revision.

import_method.description:
Source plugin for the two VapourSynth input kinds. `None` means BestSource, the
engine's default, so a project written before this field existed keeps its decode
path.

index_file.description:
Optional `.ffindex` path for the native FFMS2 input. `None` lets the engine place the
index beside the source, which is what a machine without a prepared index expects.

input_kind.description: Decode path for a newly added source.

output_folder.description: Absolute folder used when `output_mode` is `folder`; absent otherwise.

output_mode.description: Where a newly added video's output path is derived.

script.description:
Absolute path to the `.vpy` file when `input_kind` is `vapour_synth_script` and
`script_mode` is `file`.

script_mode.description:
How the script input is supplied. A document written before this field existed has
`script` set and no mode, which is read as `file`.

vapour_synth_filters.description: VapourSynth filters, in the same engine-owned JSON form.

variables.description:
Extra variables the script reads as `condor_<name>`.

The runner injects its own reserved keys into the same map and replaces them on every
open, so a document cannot change what the scene table, the paths, or the sequence
configuration say.

InputKind.description: How the project decodes the sources of videos added to its queue.

oneOf.description: Native FFMS2 decode; requires no optional dependency.
VapourSynth decode through the project's selected import method.
A VapourSynth script file the engine loads and feeds its scene variables to.

OutputMode.description: Where the output of a newly added video is written.

oneOf.description: Beside the source file, named after it.
Into one folder, named after the source file.

ScriptInputMode.description: How a `vapour_synth_script` input supplies its script.

oneOf.description: A `.vpy` file on disk, used as written.
Script text stored in the project document.

VapourSynthImporter.description: The VapourSynth source plugin that imports a video into the decode graph.

oneOf.description: FFmpegSource, which needs no index file of its own.
BestSource, the engine's default and the fastest of the four for most sources.
